title: Truchas 2D thermal boundary conditions
description: A named collection of thermal boundary-condition definitions. Each definition applies to one or more mesh face sets. The mesh must ultimately have a complete, non-overlapping boundary specification; that geometric check cannot be expressed here.

face-set-ids.description: One or more mesh face-set identifiers to which the condition applies.

type.description: Prescribe temperature on the selected face sets.

temp.description: Temperature as a constant or inline scalar function of the function arguments, including time.

type.description: Prescribe normal heat flux on the selected face sets.

flux.description: Normal heat flux as a constant or inline scalar function.

type.description: Apply convective heat transfer on the selected face sets.

htc.description: Heat-transfer coefficient as a constant or inline scalar function.

ambient-temp.description: Ambient temperature as a constant or inline scalar function.

type.description: Apply radiative heat transfer on the selected face sets.

emissivity.description: Surface emissivity as a constant or inline scalar function.

ambient-temp.description: Ambient radiative temperature as a constant or inline scalar function.

inflow.title: Thermal inflow boundary condition
inflow.description: Prescribe the temperature of material entering through selected faces. This form is used by advection-enabled coupled simulations.

type.description: Prescribe inflow temperature on the selected face sets.

temp.description: Inflow temperature as a constant or inline scalar function.

outflow.title: Thermal outflow boundary condition
outflow.description: Mark selected faces as outflow boundaries in an advection-enabled coupled simulation. The diffusive thermal flux is currently zero.

type.description: Mark the selected face sets as outflow boundaries.
